# 阿彌陀經疏鈔問辯

**ID:** X0426
**Volume:** X22
**Category:** 淨土宗部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 明 袾宏述
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0426

## Contributors
- 袾宏 (A001394)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juǎn* defensive supplement by [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng to his own *Ēmítuó jīng shūchāo* [KR6p0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0019). The work collects and answers objections raised by readers and critics in the years following the *Shūchāo*'s publication. The format is straightforward Q-and-A: each section begins with an objection (*wèn* 問) — usually a doctrinal challenge or a textual critique — and proceeds to Zhūhóng's response (*dá* 答). The author's preface is brief and explicit: "Where the criticism could be accepted, I gladly accept it. Where it could not be accepted, I refute it point by point. Where it was inconsequential, I leave it aside" (其可從者忻然從之。不可從者一一辯正。太無緊要則置弗錄).

**Abstract**

The *Wènbiàn* is a remarkable document of late-Míng Buddhist intellectual exchange. The objections it addresses come from at least three identifiable directions: (a) Tiāntái-school critics who held that Zhūhóng's synthetic reading of *niànfó* [KR6p0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0019) effectively dissolved the doctrinal distinctness of the Tiāntái Pure Land tradition associated with Sìmíng [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Zhīlǐ; (b) Chán-school critics who held that the *Shūchāo*'s treatment of *niànfó* as a form of *cānchán* 參禪 misrepresents the Chán doctrine of "no-thought" (*wúniàn* 無念); (c) lay-Buddhist objectors who raised practical questions about devotional method, the doctrinal status of recitation versus contemplation, and the relation of *niànfó* to other meritorious practice (*jīngjìn* 精進, *liù dù* 六度, etc.).

Zhūhóng's responses are characteristically irenic: the *Wènbiàn* shows him willing to concede minor textual points and to refine his own formulations, but firm on the core doctrinal claim that *niànfó* unites the major Sino-Buddhist contemplative methods. Several of the answers — particularly on the relation between *niànfó* and *jīngjìn*, and on the apparent paradox of *bù tuì duò* 不退墮 ("non-retrogression") — provide the clearest extant statement of his mature position. The *Wènbiàn* circulated together with the *Shūchāo* and the *Shìyì* [KR6p0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0020) from the late Wànlì period (c. 1584–1615 covering Zhūhóng's lifetime).
